# L&M Highways

> A professional surfacing contractor undertaking all aspects of asphalt paving —
> commercial and domestic — based at 46 St Andrews Street, Mildenhall, Suffolk,
> IP28 7HB, and working nationwide across the United Kingdom.

## Contact

- Office: 01638 493555 (+44 1638 493555)
- Mobile: 07828 092825 (+44 7828 092825), also WhatsApp
- Registered address: 46 St Andrews Street, Mildenhall, Suffolk, IP28 7HB, United Kingdom
- Office hours: Monday to Friday, 8am to 5pm
- Coverage: nationwide; local coverage across Suffolk, Norfolk and Cambridgeshire,
  including Bury St Edmunds, Newmarket, Ely, Thetford and Mildenhall

## What we do

Surfacing and asphalt paving for car parks, access roads, industrial estates,
adopted residential estates, highways and domestic driveways. We work directly for
businesses, schools, councils and property managers, and alongside main contractors
on larger schemes. We also hire out plant and accredited surfacing crews to other
contractors delivering their own surfacing works.

## Accreditations

- Registered with Avetta for main contractor supply chain prequalification
- All employees and operatives hold valid CSCS cards
- Plant operators hold CPCS or NPORS accreditations
